title: Search
description:
You comb your surroundings, or hunt for what eludes you.

Make a {{jet}} ({{esprit}} + {{perception}}) for what your senses can pick up, or ({{intelligence}} + {{investigation}}) for what has to be worked out. The GM sets the {{dd}}.

Against a {{cache}} creature, your {{jet}} ({{esprit}} + {{perception}}) is opposed by its {{jet}} ({{dexterite}} + {{discretion}}). On a success, it is no longer {{cache}} to you.
